recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Any future addition of lab-specific specimen rejection reason codes should be a new OO/terminology decision, not a delayed FHIR-5629 source fix.

additional_context: FHIR-10398 later supplied the generic not-performed code, current THO/R6 artifacts contain that code, and current Observation notes/examples cover specimen-unsatisfactory and rejection details through extensible coded dataAbsentReason/valueCodeableConcept guidance. The active Observation definitions are CodeableConcept 0..1 with an extensible DataAbsentReason binding; the value set includes THO data-absent-reason codes, including not-performed; and specimen-unsatisfactory can be represented with more specific coding under the existing extensible model.
